Statistics student at Utah State University (B.S. expected December 2026, minors in Mathematics and Psychology), building toward a career in data science and analytics-driven business decisions. I plan to continue to a master's in data science.

I work with R and SQL, and my projects cover relational database analysis, web scraping and data cleaning, Monte Carlo simulation, and regression modeling. I like turning messy data into clear answers that someone can act on.

Outside the classroom, I served two years as a full-time volunteer in Wisconsin, where I coordinated logistics and training for 150+ people, and I currently work in Home Depot's Millworks department, where I build customer quotes and translate requirements into recommendations.

See my [projects](projects.qmd) or [resume](resume.qmd).
